 Pang Ron-Pei Jing storm into Hylo Open semis in Germany
 Pang Ron-Pei Jing storm into Hylo Open semis in Germany
 30-Oct-2026, 23:57 30 Oct 2026, 23:57 K. Parkaran Share The Malaysian pair have now made it to five World Tour semi-finals since pairing up in May.
 Hoo Pang Ron-Lai Pei Jing defeated Hong Kong pair Chan Yin Chak-Ng Tsz Yau 21-17, 21-17. (Bernama pic) 
 PETALING JAYA : Mixed doubles shuttlers Hoo Pang Ron-Lai Pei Jing kept their momentum in the European circuit going, reaching the semi-finals at the Hylo Open in Germany. 
 The world No 24 Malaysian pair took just 30 minutes to beat Hong Kong’s seventh-seeded pair Chan Yin Chak-Ng Tsz Yau 21-17, 21-17 in the World Tour Super 500 event at the Saarlandhalle Indoor Arena in Saarbrücken.
 In tomorrow’s last four match, Pang Ron-Pei Jing will meet either German pair Marvin Seidel-Nguyen Thuc Phuong or French duo Thom Gicquel-Delphine Delrue.
 This is the fifth semi-final appearance at World Tour championships in five months for Pang Ron-Pei Jing, achieved within just 10 tournaments since the independent pair started playing together.
 They were runners-up at the Super 750 French Open last week, and the China Open in September.
